page: Google Cloud Platform z4d-highmem-48-standardlssd is a storage-optimized virtual machine belonging to the z4d server family. It is equipped with 48 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 CPU architecture and features 378.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 7.88 GB of RAM per core. The instance includes local NVMe SSD storage capabilities and does not feature any GPU accelerators.

This server configuration provides a high memory-to-vCPU ratio, positioning it as a resource-dense option for workloads requiring significant memory capacity alongside dedicated compute resources. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the combination of dedicated x86_64 vCPUs and integrated NVMe SSD storage offers a balanced allocation of processing power and fast local storage access, minimizing the need for external storage overhead in data-intensive operations.

The z4d-highmem-48-standardlssd is designed for workloads that demand substantial memory and high-speed local storage. Suitable applications include relational and non-relational databases, in-memory caching systems, data analytics pipelines, and enterprise applications requiring consistent, dedicated CPU performance.
